newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KPN's Dik sees shareholder value from split.
newsitem.headline: KPN's Dik sees shareholder value from split.

text.p: Wim Dik, chairman of Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV, said on Tuesday he saw the proposed separate listings of its post and telecoms units delivering value to KPN shareholders.
"They (shareholders) will benefit by having two dedicated companies, people focused on their own goals and their own shareholder value," Dik said in a telephone interview.

"It focuses people better when they really fight for their own companies in the open market, judged by the market and the stock exchange," he said. The company earlier said it was aiming for separate listings in the first half of 1998.
"It may take a year from today to carefully...prepare a split up. The break up will be effective towards the end of the first half of 1998, that's what we're striving for," said Dik.
"The expectations from analysts was that separate post and telecoms shares added together might have a higher value than a KPN share," he added.
Asked his own view he replied: "I'm not an analyst and because I'm an insider I want to keep my mouth shut." -- Keiron Henderson, Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
